title: Day 727 — Sheinbaum Says Ayotzinapa Case 'Not Closed,' Announces New Report Ahead of 12th Anniversary; Warns of Hurricane Polo
detail: At her Monday mañanera on September 28, 2026 (Day 727), President Sheinbaum said the investigation into the 2014 disappearance of the 43 Ayotzinapa students is "not closed" and announced a new report, to be presented by Deputy Interior Minister Arturo Medina and special prosecutor Mauricio Pazarán, on new investigative methodologies and lines of inquiry ahead of the 12th anniversary. She also warned of Category 3 Hurricane Polo, forecast to make landfall in Comondú, Baja California Sur, in the afternoon, and said employment had grown by roughly 1.2–1.3 million people to 60.7 million. She criticised the UN's absence on international conflicts and anticipated a mandatory labour certificate for avocado exports.
